IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Wednesday, August 19, 2026**

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is running hot with **$44.80/hr** across 68 Inside JW calls split between Parsons Electric on the Polaris Forge Data Center (working 6-10's with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** if you're 100+ miles out, plus **$100 incentive M-F, $1 [per hour] Sat/Sun**) and Hunt Electric plus Northern Valley on Grand Forks Air Base (4-10's with 8 hours OT Fridays, **$100/day per diem** for ND license holders). This board's got legs—111 hands deep and every call tagged with the same rate. Data center and base work running parallel.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** is the cream: four contractors (Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, Kelso Burnett) all feeding Microsoft Mount Pleasant at **$62.51/hr**, 53 calls total on a board with only 76 hands. Long sleeves and safety toes required, but this is premium work. Start dates already locked in late June.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** has Industrial Electric dominating with 21 calls on Eli Lilly new construction (K153 Southside) and IU Hospital work—one call hitting **$54.75/hr** for Inside JW. Temperature Control and construction experience pays here. Book still has room.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is steady volume: 48 calls across Whitehead Electric, Inglett & Stubbs, and Miller Electrical. Work's tagged at **$40–$40.90/hr** for cable splicers and feeder pulls at QTS Fayetteville, mostly 4-10's. 312 hands on the board means selective hiring.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is a REPOST board: Cupertino, Pieper, Gurtz, and MJ Electric all calling for Port Washington Data Center work (30–13 calls each). **JW wage plus $10/hr base wage increase** on multiple calls. This is fresh ink.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is pulling hands for Micron ID1 at **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day per diem x 7 days** and **$20/hr travel pay**—PLA job leverage. Cache Valley and Quality Electric both running it. Only 48 hands board-wide.

Data centers and semiconductor plants are vacuuming up hands across the northern tier; geographic incentives and shift premiums are doing the real work.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Wednesday, August 19, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is moving volume. Forty-six calls, nearly full board. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is hiring hard—40 Journeyman on distro out of Columbus ($125 nights stayed, $125 bonus on 10-hour days, 6-10s, CDL required); another 9 JL down in Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional Fri/Sat. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS wants 6 JL in Johnstown with cable splicing experience (OSHA 10, Class A CDL). This is workhorse distro work, decent per diems, long hours.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is the data-center play heating up. Parsons Electric alone has 58 Inside JW calls at **$44.80/hr** on the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood—that's **$100/day non-taxed per diem (100+ mile GPS radius), plus $100/day Mon-Fri and $150 Sat/Sun incentive pay**, 6-10s. Another **$100/day bonus if you hold an ND license**. Hunt Electric's got 10 more at the Air Base on 4-10s with 8 hours OT Friday. Cold winters, hot work.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** offers the range. Meta's Rosendin job (46 Inside JW at **$40/hr** with **$15 incentive for 90% of 60 hours/week, all OT double time**) undercuts the New Mexico play—Michels, Mass Electric, and Summit Line are all pulling 5–46 hands across Chaparral and Santa Teresa at **$53–$55/hr**, double-time OT, some with **$1,121/week relocation** if you're 350+ miles out. NM license required on some, not others.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is thin on straight lineman work (45 calls, 75 hands total) but the highest single rate on the board hits **$76.59/hr**—though most calls are database admin, telecom, and laborer roles. Real money's short here.

**LU-71 remains the safest move for volume and per diem; Grand Forks is where the incentive stack lives. Data centers and energized transmission are pulling hands north and east.**

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Wednesday, August 19, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is running the board hard—28 calls chasing 46 hands on Intel Ronler Acres in Hillsboro. Charter Mechanical has 9 high-purity fitter slots (#71589) plus 3 orbital welder tool-install spots (#71459). Harder's got 3 more fitter tool install/demo calls (#71593) at the same Intel campus, plus 3 BIM detailer spots back at their Portland office (#71463). No rate posted, but volume like this moves fast.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is pushing 18 calls into 61 hands—mostly BCS Mechanical's Sego Project in West Valley running heavy. Fifteen JW pipefitters and 13 JW plumbers, both on 4-10s, 6:00 AM–4:30 PM with OT starting Aug 3. DSI's also hiring 6 JW pipefitters for QTS in Eagle Mountain on a 5-8 schedule (working 5-10s + 1-8) at **$10.00/hr**—that's the specialty outlier. Apprentices welcome on Sego too.

**LU-325 Fredericton, NB** has 3 calls and 84 hands queued—all Irving Oil Refinery Lorneville shutdown work. Stuart Olson's got 40 slots (40 other, 6-10s day shift, Job #4); two more contractor calls at 33 and 11 hands respectively, same refinery, same shutdown work. Classic East Coast refinery sprint.

**LU-213 St John, NB** mirrors the momentum with 11 calls chasing 38 hands, also Irving Oil Refinery. Cam's running 8 journeyman instrument tech slots (days, GPMA), another 6 night shift instrument tech spots (GPMA), plus 5 more day shift (GPMA). B&W's got 6 JW pipefitters on NMA short-term. Instrument techs own this board.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 8 calls into 27 hands with **$53.00/hr** on Graham's Cenovus maintenance contract—5 pipefitters and 5 combo welders (test required), 4-10s. Gem's fab shop wants 1 pipefitter and 7 combo welders on 6-10s. Ineos outage adds 3 more pipefitters on spotty OT.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is thin (2 calls, 6 hands) but solid: PMI's running combo welder work at Ellsworth Air Force Base with **$100/day per diem**, plus 1 plumber slot at Fort Meade VA Hospital in Sturgis. Both require OSHA 10 and background checks.

Refinery shutdowns and semiconductor fab tooling are pulling hands northeast and west simultaneously—industrial process work is where the density is.
